title: DNA extraction using Zymo kit
author: Tsu-Chun Hung
materials: Put in the automated DNA extraction machine

steps.title: Add beads and lysis solution
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 1 mm beads, then 600 µL of lysis solution, then 200 µL of 0.5 mm beads to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, and finally add 9–10 µg of sample to the same tube.

steps.title: Bead‑beating sample
steps.instruction: Place the 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube in the MixMill and run at 30 rpm for 4 minutes (00:04:00).

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 17.0 × g, 25 °C for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Bind DNA to magnetic beads
steps.instruction: In the first well of a 96‑deep‑well plate, add 600 µL DNA binding buffer, then add 200 µL of the lysate (transferred from the 15 mL centrifuge microtube) – usually added last, and finally add 25 µL magnetic beads (shake the bottle and pipette before use).

steps.title: Wash DNA – Wash 1
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Wash 1 to the second well of the 96‑deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Wash DNA – Wash 2 (first)
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Wash 2 to the third well of the 96‑deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Wash DNA – Wash 2 (second)
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Wash 2 to the fourth well of the 96‑deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL water to the fifth well of the 96‑deep‑well plate.
